title: Diagram: what an agent reads, and when
description: Kilobytes read per case in a generated video project, split into the starter, the template's Director add-ons, and the video docs, crew and records. Saying hi reads 113 KB before the first reply; a one-line note, a script request and a research worker are shown too. Below, the Director's reads in order as grouped steps. Video files are the largest share in every case.
